 Projected Lineup: Nov. 7 at Nashville
 By 
 Chris Pinkert 
 St. Louis Blues 
 November 07, 2026 
 Link copied 
 Mason McTavish will take warmups Saturday in Nashville but will be a gametime decision, according to Blues Head Coach Jim Montgomery.
 McTavish did not practice with the team on Friday, but Montgomery said Saturday morning that he does expect him to be able to play.
 The puck drops on Saturday's game against Nashville, who has won three straight games, at noon at Bridgestone Arena (Blue Note+, 101 ESPN).
 Montgomery said he would make a few adjustments to his forward lines Saturday, moving Connor McMichael to center and Dalibor Dvorsky to the wing. He also said he liked Aleksanteri Kaskimaki in a Top 6 forward role on Thursday in New Jersey, so Kaskimaki will stay in that spot on a line with Jake Neighbours and McTavish (if available).
 No changes will be made on defense.
 Joel Hofer will start in goal.
 Below is a projected lineup based on Montgomery's pregame media availability but will be updated if additional changes are available.
 PROJECTED LINEUP 
 Forwards 
 Dylan Holloway - Robert Thomas - Jimmy Snuggerud
Aleksanteri Kaskimaki - Mason McTavish - Jake Neighbours
Dalibor Dvorsky - Connor McMichael - Pavel Buchnevich
Alexey Toropchenko - Pius Suter - Ross Johnston
 Defense 
 Philip Broberg - Brandon Carlo
Colton Parayko - Justin Barron
Cam Fowler - Adam Jiricek
 Goalie 
 Joel Hofer
